# CTA6: structure (round 1)

This outline is generated from `data/sources.csv` and `data/timeline.csv`. It draws no conclusions. Each section lists the source ids and timeline ids that map to it. Wording rule: contested labels are attributed to whoever applied them (for example, a designation by a named government body). Where sources disagree, both are cited and the timeline row is marked people-disagree.
